details:
What I want is somethin' similar ta pronouns, but instead of let people add their own age in it, jus have two age ranges. Minor & Adult. That way people can't joke around wit it.

This also allows otha' stuff ta be connected to if people use it, such as filterin' world instances as Minor, Adult or Mixed, so that people can hang out with those at least somewhere around their own age range.

Some adults like myself would really prefer ta only hang out around otha' adults most of the time an don't wanna always deal wit kids, an really honestly don't feel safe due ta minors who often lie about their age or hit on adults.

Likewise, it allows minors ta not have ta be around adults if they don't wanna an they can feel safer if adults make them feel unsafe.

It could also be useful as a tag fer makin' worlds too fer Adults, so if you add this tag, you can apply it ta worlds where people can make worlds fer adults only that minors can't search.

Meanin', if they have Adult in their tag, they can see avatars or worlds that also have that tag, but minors can't.

Ta 'semi-verify' ta use the Adult tag, you could have them put in their birth month & year.

It won't be as official as the Verified thin', but it will still help.

I am sure a lot of people would very much appreciate it.

It would help standard users an creators alike.
title: Age Tag
